entries.name: Danmaku
entries.description: Overlays scrolling "danmaku" style comments on top of the video, similar to Bilibili/Niconico style comment streams. Fetches and renders comment tracks as a video overlay while media plays.
entries.author: xjbeta

source.curatorNote: Release asset confirmed at v0.1.15; Info.json identifier and ghVersion read directly from repo.

entries.name: OpenSubtitles
entries.tagline: Official OpenSubtitles.com subtitle provider for IINA
entries.description: Official plugin from the IINA team integrating OpenSubtitles.com as a subtitle provider directly inside IINA's subtitle search, letting users search for and download subtitles without leaving the player.
entries.author: IINA Developers

source.curatorNote: Official IINA org plugin; listed in awesome-iina. Release asset for v0.9.6 confirmed downloadable.

entries.name: Online Media
entries.tagline: Play YouTube and other streaming sites via youtube-dl/yt-dlp
entries.description: Official IINA plugin (formerly plugin-ytdl) that resolves streaming URLs from YouTube and other supported sites through youtube-dl/yt-dlp so they can be opened and played directly inside IINA.
entries.author: IINA Developers

source.curatorNote: One of the three seed sources for this registry; release asset name still uses the legacy "plugin-ytdl" prefix.

entries.name: User Scripts
entries.tagline: Run custom Lua/JS userscripts inside IINA
entries.description: Official IINA plugin that lets advanced users load and run custom userscripts against the player, similar in spirit to mpv userscripts, for bespoke automation and behavior tweaks.
entries.author: IINA Developers

entries.name: More Seeking
entries.tagline: Extra keyboard seeking shortcuts for IINA
entries.description: Official IINA plugin adding additional seeking key bindings and options beyond IINA's defaults, for finer-grained navigation through media playback.
entries.author: IINA Developers

source.curatorNote: No GitHub Release found at check time; codeload zip of default branch (main) confirmed to resolve.

entries.name: Jellyfin
entries.tagline: Browse and play your Jellyfin library with automatic subtitles
entries.description: Adds a Jellyfin media browser sidebar to IINA and automatically fetches matching subtitles for content played from a Jellyfin server, bridging self-hosted media libraries into the player.
entries.author: Mateusz Hajder

source.curatorNote: Highest-starred community plugin found; Info.json exposes ghRepo/identifier but no ghVersion field was present so update tracking falls back to unversioned ghVersion checks.

entries.name: Bookmarks
entries.tagline: Add, edit, and organize media bookmarks from a sidebar
entries.description: A media bookmark manager plugin that lets users add, edit, and organize timestamped bookmarks within their media, exposed through a dedicated IINA sidebar tab.
entries.author: Wyatt Walsh

entries.name: Jellyfin (ada-bee)
entries.tagline: Browse and watch your Jellyfin server's content in IINA
entries.description: A second, independently maintained Jellyfin integration that lets you browse and watch content from a Jellyfin server directly from within IINA.
entries.author: ada-bee

source.curatorNote: Distinct project from mhajder/iina-jellyfin, same category; kept both since they're separate maintained codebases.

entries.name: YouTube
entries.tagline: Browse and watch YouTube videos inside IINA
entries.description: Adds a YouTube browsing sidebar to IINA so videos can be searched, selected, and played without leaving the player, from the same author as the ada-bee Jellyfin plugin.
entries.author: ada-bee

entries.name: File Viewer
entries.tagline: Bookmark folders and browse directory trees to quickly play files
entries.description: Lets users bookmark folders, browse directory structures, and quickly play video files within them, functioning as a lightweight file-system-aware media browser inside IINA.
entries.author: qkong

entries.name: Playlist Pro
entries.tagline: Manage local and online playlists side by side
entries.description: A playlist management plugin for seamless handling of both local and online playlists, aimed at users who juggle mixed media sources within a single IINA playlist workflow.
entries.author: Danial Abdoli

source.curatorNote: Repo description self-promotes stars; verified release asset independently of that framing.

entries.name: Anime4K
entries.tagline: Real-time anime-oriented upscaling via Anime4K shaders
entries.description: Integrates the Anime4K GLSL shader set into IINA for real-time upscaling and denoising tuned for anime-style content, applied on top of mpv's shader pipeline.
entries.author: yorkyang2333

entries.name: Jump to Frame
entries.description: Adds a command and OSD input for jumping directly to a specific frame number, useful for frame-accurate review and editing workflows.
entries.author: Ch1re

source.curatorNote: Listed in awesome-iina under the author's other repo, bbeny123/iina-jump-to-frame.

entries.name: HDR Screenshot
entries.description: Captures screenshots that preserve HDR tone mapping by shelling out to FFmpeg rather than relying on IINA's standard SDR screenshot path, aimed at HDR source material.
entries.author: Ch1re

entries.name: Save Subtitles
entries.tagline: Export SRT subtitles, with optional delay retiming
entries.description: Exports the currently loaded subtitle track to an SRT file, with an option to apply a timing delay/offset during export so out-of-sync subtitles can be corrected on save.
entries.author: Ch1re

source.curatorNote: Repo was renamed to bbeny123/iina-save-subs on GitHub; original awesome-iina URL (iina-save-subs-with-delay) redirects there. release asset verified at the current repo location.

entries.name: Recorder
entries.tagline: Clip a video segment using FFmpeg
entries.description: Adds a recorder/clipper tool with its own sidebar tab that uses FFmpeg to cut a segment out of the currently playing video and save it as a standalone clip.
entries.author: Daniel Ifechukwude Chinye

source.curatorNote: No GitHub Release found; codeload zip of default branch (main) confirmed to resolve.

entries.name: Skip Intro
entries.tagline: Automatically skip intros, recaps, and end credits
entries.description: Watches playback and automatically skips over detected intros, recaps, and credits sequences, reducing manual seeking during binge-watching sessions.
entries.author: pparanoiidd

source.curatorNote: No GitHub Release found; codeload zip of default branch (main) confirmed to resolve.

entries.name: Whisperina
entries.tagline: Generate subtitles on the fly using OpenAI Whisper models
entries.description: Runs OpenAI Whisper speech-recognition models against the currently playing audio to generate subtitles for media that doesn't already have them, entirely from within IINA.
entries.author: yux

source.curatorNote: No GitHub Release found; codeload zip of default branch (main) confirmed to resolve.

entries.name: Playlist Sort Collection
entries.tagline: Sort the IINA playlist by duration or by filename
entries.description: A small collection repo bundling two playlist-sorting plugins for IINA: sort the playlist panel by video duration (shortest first) or alphabetically by filename, each added as a context-menu/Plugins-menu item.
entries.author: dotWee

source.curatorNote: Monorepo of two sub-plugins (playlist-sort-by-duration, playlist-sort-by-filename), each with its own .iinaplugin release asset rather than a single root Info.json; no single stable identifier exists at the repo root, so identifier is null and update mechanism is "none" pending per-subplugin modeling.

_comment: source.type and source.curatorNote are curator-owned fields, hand-authored by whoever seeded or reviewed this entry.
